call_sites.usage: wholesale upsert of p.ssn into portal_patients
wholesale upsert of p.name into portal_patients
wholesale upsert of p.patientId as patient_id PK
GET /v2/patients/{patientId} on login refresh and nightly sync
dynamic key iteration renders ssn as a labeled row on the admin detail view
same dynamic renderer on the patient profile

write_path_evidence.quote: INSERT INTO portal_patients (patient_id, name, dob, gender, ssn, phone, email, addr_line1, city, state, zip)

required_changes.description: Step 1/3 — schema migration: drop or relax ssn TEXT NOT NULL (new migration). Must ship with the insert-path and view changes below.

Step 2/3 — insert path: stop writing p.ssn; cache given/family instead of the v2 name string; read identifier.value for patient_id and GET-by-id. Keep the wholesale-upsert idiom. INC-4471 is about sync shape, not about keeping SSN after the producer removes it.

evidence.quote: INSERT INTO portal_patients (patient_id, name, dob, gender, ssn, phone, email, addr_line1, city, state, zip)

required_changes.description: Step 3/3 — views: update admin/profile dynamic labels so given/family render and SSN is no longer a labeled row. Ships with the migration and insert-path changes.

evidence.quote: var labels = { dob: 'Date of Birth', ssn: 'SSN', addr_line1: 'Address Line 1', patient_id: 'Patient ID', updated_at: 'Updated At' };

existing_tests.name: admin detail renders ssn from the cache row
existing_tests.why: Asserts res.text contains cacheRow.ssn; after SSN is gone from cache the assertion is wrong even if the page is correct.

recommended_new_tests.name: sync upsert succeeds when PIS payload has no ssn
recommended_new_tests.fails_first_because: ssn TEXT NOT NULL and the column list still bind p.ssn; a v3 payload makes the INSERT fail until the migration and sync mapping change. (Sync itself is currently untested — this is a new test.)

blockers.summary: ssn TEXT NOT NULL, the wholesale INSERT of p.ssn, and dynamic views that render the cache row must ship together; a migration without the write-path change (or the reverse) fails at runtime.

gaps.deficiency: Nightly sync tallies per-row upsert errors in a summary line nobody reads unless the total spikes; a v3-shaped payload would fail every row and page on-call, but a partial mapping bug would be silent.

evidence.quote: individual upsert errors are logged and skipped, tallied in a summary line nobody reads unless the total spikes

gaps.recommended_instrumentation: Log upsert skip counts by error class (not-null / missing column / http), never by patient payload field values.

grade_reasoning: NOT NULL on a retired-but-still-written SSN column, dynamic key-iteration templates, and an untested sync job mean the write agent has to make schema-and-display calls that a mechanical patch cannot own. Human-impact is HIGH; that does not change this grade, but the gate should see both.

confidence.rationale: DDL, sync mapping, and templates are explicit. Uncertainty is only how Digital Experience wants given/family shown on the dynamic profile rows.

evidence.quote: do not remove — breaks sync, see INC-4471
